name: Kruger National Park
blurb: Elephants, lions and the grass and mopane that feed the lowveld.

tip.title: Thin the elephants
tip.text: Select African bush elephants and lower their numbers. Watch the mopane, knobthorn and marula trees, then the browsers and predators that share them.

notes: The story and why it matters come from the Wikipedia articles listed below (Kruger National Park, African bush elephant, Impala). Individual species and links have not been checked one by one. Feeding links that match a GloBI (Global Biotic Interactions) record are marked in the node details, with a link to the records. A few links were added from GloBI records.

nodes.desc: A tall grass of the open grazing lands that zebra, wildebeest, buffalo and impala all feed on.
The dominant tree across the northern park. Elephants, giraffes and antelope browse its leaves, and the mopane worm caterpillar feeds on it.
The most numerous large mammal in the park. It grazes after the rains and browses woody plants in the dry season, and is prey for most large carnivores.
Grazes grasses on the open plains and is common prey for lions, hyenas and wild dogs.
A grazing antelope of the open grasslands, hunted by lions, hyenas, leopards and wild dogs.
Forms large herds on the grazing lands and is a main prey of lions.

nodes.name: Giraffe
nodes.desc: Browses the leaves of tall trees such as knobthorn and mopane, reaching food other herbivores cannot.

nodes.name: African bush elephant
nodes.desc: A mixed feeder on grass, leaves, bark and fruit. Its feeding opens up thickets and riverside forest, and calves are sometimes taken by lions.
Hunts in clans and also scavenges. It eats a wide range of prey, from impala to buffalo, and often feeds on lion kills.
A pack-hunting predator of antelope and zebra. Its packs are endangered in South Africa.
A scavenger that feeds on the soft tissue of carcasses and is among the first vultures to reach one. It is critically endangered, in part from poisoned carcasses.
A soaring eagle that takes live prey and also feeds on carrion.
The top predator of the park, hunting zebra, wildebeest, buffalo, giraffe and impala. Its kills feed hyenas and vultures.
A solitary ambush predator that takes impala, wildebeest, zebra and other medium prey.
Falls mostly from September to May and sets the pace of grass and leaf growth.
Savanna fires clear dead grass and let fresh growth sprout for grazers.

nodes.name: Termites, dung beetles & fungi
nodes.desc: Break down dung, carcasses and dead plants and return nutrients to the soil.

story: Kruger National Park in South Africa drew close to 2 million visitors in 2024. African bush elephants live in its woodlands and grasslands. They have been listed as Endangered since 2021.
matters: Poaching in the 1970s and 1980s caused some of the largest killings of elephants in history. Rangers reported 14,606 illegal killings across 29 countries between 2003 and 2015.
